entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand you sent me is a piece of junk. It's completely broken and I want my money back. Now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into this for you. To start, could I get your name and order number please?
It's Mark Peterson. Order number is VF987-554. And don't waste my time with a bunch of questions. The thing is not working. I've had it.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your account now... I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse. I understand you're saying it's not working, but to make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Are you listening to me? It's defective! It won't sync with my app, the pulse reading is all over the place... it's just broken! I don't want troubleshooting, I want a refund.
I understand your frustration completely. For a defective device, my standard process is to connect you with our technical support team who can...

NO! I'm not talking to another person. This is the last time I'm saying it. Give me a refund or I want to speak to your manager. I'll be sure to leave a review on every website I can find about this piece of garbage and your terrible service.

Okay, Mark, please, there's no need for that. I can see you're a VIP member with us and we certainly don't want you to have this experience. Let me check the return eligibility for you right now. One moment.
Fine. But this is your last chance.
Thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your order date, and I've confirmed our policy. It looks like you are well within the 90-day return window.
So you can do the refund then?

Yes, absolutely. I am processing a full refund to your original payment method right now. I'll also email you a prepaid shipping label to send the defective unit back to us. And for all the trouble this has caused, as you're a valued VIP member, I've gone ahead and added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for a future purchase.
Oh. A full refund... and a credit? Well. Okay, then. I guess that's acceptable. Thank you.
You are most welcome, Mark. You should see that refund confirmation and the shipping label in your email within the next 15 minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Sarah.
It was my pleasure to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
